active_family: state-aware normalized-innovation conditional law with one stochastic source and one shared generative core; first backend remains AR flow matching unless diagnostics justify a switch
single_framework_candidate_gate: A framework candidate must freeze one recipe and evaluate it on iv_only, anchor_only, and joint. Allowed differences are input/output dimensionality, support transforms, input heads, decoder heads, and deterministic channel/group balancing. Scope-specific losses, loss weights, backend, prior, sampler, calibration layer, or glued separately sampled decks are not allowed for a framework claim.
current_framework_status: Active data now uses observed Yahoo ^VIX as factor:vix/factor:vix_logret. The IV-derived vix_proxy path is removed from active loaders and train/eval/audit scripts. 719a remains the methodology/risk-manager baseline family, but it is not yet a real-VIX tri-scope champion because the anchor/joint dimensionality changed. The next framework candidate must rerun one frozen recipe on iv_only, anchor_only, and joint using the 14-anchor observed panel.
normalization_policy: support-aware encoded levels; daily encoded increments; history-only fixed EWMA/RMS scale with robust floor; zero center remains the deployable incumbent. 679a/680a falsified full EWMA mean centering as too deterministic even with rollout-energy repair; 681a falsified EWMA drift as an added conditioning feature because it still over-amplified drift/mean-reversion and damaged level/path allocation.
backend_switch_policy: Do not switch AR/one-shot, flow/diffusion/copula, or Transformer/other backbone until required audits classify the failure as backend failure rather than data framing, reconstruction, conditionality, diversity, dependency, or distribution shift.
research_axis_policy: Change one axis per iteration unless diagnostics prove coupling. Axes: data_object, temporal_factorization, backend, encoder, dependency_structure, calibration.
literature_search_policy: Search papers/official sources during diagnosis when a failure class repeats twice, a methodology/backend/encoder/temporal switch is considered, a normalization failure is not understood, local fixes are exhausted, or model limitation is about to be claimed.
current_bottleneck: Need a single frozen real-VIX framework candidate across iv_only, anchor_only, and joint. Known pathology to monitor is sticky credit-spread increments: AAA/BBB OAS day-to-day movement is often zero or near-zero, so continuous generators can over-move them. Treat a sparse/sticky-increment repair as a generic low-activity-channel adapter only if diagnostics prove it is necessary; otherwise document it as a limitation.

Current panel has 25 IV cells plus 14 factor levels and 14 factor increments, including factor:vix and factor:vix_logret, with no vix_proxy. Focused VIX pipeline tests passed. Prior 732a dispersion-calibration result remains rejected.
next_step_recommendation: Run the first real-VIX tri-scope framework-lock iteration: choose the 719a-style normalized-innovation recipe as the baseline, retrain/evaluate the same frozen recipe on iv_only, anchor_only, and joint with the updated 14-anchor panel, then classify failures before adding any new knob. If AAA/BBB OAS stickiness is the only serious defect, either document it as a limitation or test one generic sparse/sticky low-activity-channel adapter with the same rule across scopes.
